items.prompt: How do the Owner's Project Requirements and Basis of Design differ?
items.answer: The OPR describes the outcomes and criteria the owner needs. The BOD explains the design team's technical approach for meeting them.
items.explanation: They connect the reason for the facility to the proposed solution.

source_refs.locator: Documentation Contents, Owner's Project Requirements and Basis of Design

items.variation: Learn the distinction; exact document names and scope may vary.

practice.question: Name the document in this short statement.
practice.template: The [[Owner’s Project Requirements]] describe the outcomes and criteria the owner needs.
practice.hint: Its common abbreviation has three letters.

items.prompt: What different roles do an uninterruptible power supply and a backup generator commonly play?
items.answer: The UPS supports continuity through short interruptions and power disturbances; a generator can support a longer loss of the normal supply when the designed backup arrangement takes over.
items.explanation: They address related but different parts of power continuity.
items.variation: UPS technologies and transfer arrangements differ; this is not an electrical switching sequence.

practice.question: Recall the equipment name, rather than selecting it.
practice.template: A [[UPS]] commonly supports continuity through short interruptions and power disturbances.

items.prompt: Why does the delivery schedule need time for submittal review before fabrication and delivery?
items.answer: The proposed equipment and coordinated details need review before downstream commitments. Planning that sequence reduces late discoveries and schedule disruption.
items.explanation: An arrival date alone hides the decisions needed to make delivery usable.

source_refs.locator: Section B-4, Submission, submittal log and interrelated items

practice.question: Order this simplified submittal-to-delivery chain.
steps: Prepare and coordinate the required submittal
Complete the required review and resolve issues
Proceed with authorized fabrication and delivery
practice.hint: Think about what needs to be reviewed before a downstream commitment.
